    Right modules, representation-finite algebras, and the radical of ind(mod A) #

    • Right A-modules are modelled as ModuleCat Aᵐᵒᵖ.
    • IsRepresentationFinite k Aᵐᵒᵖ: finitely many isomorphism classes of finite-dimensional indecomposable right modules.
    • IndSkeleton k A: one representative of each isomorphism class of finite-dimensional indecomposable right modules, indexed by Fin n; the full subcategory on them is ind(mod A).
    • The categorical radical J of ind(mod A) and its powers: J(X, Y) is spanned by the radical morphisms f (those with 1 - f g invertible for all g : Y ⟶ X), and J^{n+1}(X, Y) is spanned by composites f g with f radical and g ∈ J^n, all intermediate objects being indecomposable.
    • Irr(X, Y) = J(X, Y) / J²(X, Y).
    • Almost split sequences.

    Conventions of that paper: modules are finite-dimensional right modules, and maps compose from left to right, so the manuscript's fg is Lean's f ≫ g.

    References #

    • Multiplicative bases and deformations of representation-finite algebras, https://github.com/haruhisa-enomoto/multiplicative-bases-deformations. Numbered statements cited here refer to it.
